# Navigate to Git Sync

The Git Sync interface in Grafana Cloud provides a centralized location to view and manage your synced repositories and dashboards. This interface displays the sync status for all connected repositories and allows you to perform synchronization actions.

To navigate to Git Sync, complete the following steps:

1. Log in to your Grafana server with an account that has the Grafana Admin flag set.

1. Select **Administration > General > Provisioning** in the left-side menu to access the Git Sync configuration screen.

1. Review the Git Sync dashboard displaying your connected repositories.

The Git Sync page displays with a list of connected repositories and their current sync status. Each repository shows the number of synced dashboards and indicates if any dashboards require attention due to modifications or conflicts.

In the next milestone, you'll learn how to view synced dashboards in a repository.
